_comment2: Edit the values below. Do not remove any keys.

matching._comment2: fuzzy_enabled: use fuzzy matching for artist/album/title
matching._comment4: use_duration: include track duration in matching to reduce false positives
matching._comment5: duration_tolerance_seconds: how many seconds apart two tracks can be and still match

performance._comment: max_threads: number of parallel threads for scanning. 0 = auto (CPU count)
performance._comment2: cache_enabled: cache organized folder scan to speed up future runs
performance._comment3: cache_file: where to store the metadata cache.

resume._comment: If the script is interrupted, it can resume from where it left off.

output._comment: Where logs and CSV reports are saved.

acoustid._comment: enabled: set to true to be offered fingerprint matching after the main scan
acoustid._comment2: fpcalc_path: path to fpcalc.exe, or just 'fpcalc' if it is in your PATH
acoustid._comment3: similarity_threshold: how similar two fingerprints must be to count as a match (0-100)
acoustid._comment4: fp_cache_file: where to cache fingerprints to avoid re-scanning on future runs
